text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Haaah.
That was so good!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thank ya kindly for gettin' the watermelon ice-cold!
It cooled me right down to my chest.
choice_data_list: Pass on my thanks to everyone in the village.
Be sure to pass on my thanks to everyone in the village, okay?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll let them know
that you were thrilled too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
We ate watermelon,
and we worked hard on our training.
There's nothing left undone now!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I was able to grow, right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That's mighty fine to hear, yes it is.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Then the Shuka Sho'll be... a breeze, for sure, yeah!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A'ight, let's get on the bus.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
City-san!
So you're participating in the training camp too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Work-wise, I couldn't make it for the whole schedule, but...
it's a great opportunity to pack a lot into a short time.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah! Could it be...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Are you getting ready to enter a big race?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold City currently isn't running in any major races.
It's only natural for Yukino Bijin to think so, but...
choice_data_list: (Come to think of it, is there even a reason not to race...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...No, I haven't scheduled any.
I just want to keep my body from going soft.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... S-Sorry 'bout that,
I got a bit ahead of myself.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm just a fan, after all...
As long as City-san runs, I'm happy.
That's all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Because the way you run, City-san,
is just so insanely "beautiful"...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sorry,
for getting your hopes up.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?!
Why're you apologizin' for?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, they must've had a reason, so it's unreasonable to ask.
Like being busy with work...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
A reason?
I'm just running away...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: City-san?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Hey.
Taking a deep breath is really important.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"If you feel like you're about to be crushed,
remember this."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Grains...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...No, it's nothing.
Forget it."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Good luck at the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Thank ye kindly!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
City-san always comes to cheer me on...
She's so kind.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...I gotta give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the summer training camp came to an end.
